channels.name: console
channels.note: AutoDev's shipped console transport — the decision packet prints in the terminal. No credentials.

channels.name: telegram
channels.note: AutoDev's 'file' transport drops the packet in .autodev/outbox/; ops/notify-telegram.sh forwards it with `openclaw message send --channel telegram`, the same path the GUTS bridge already uses. Credentials stay in openclaw's own store (~/.openclaw); the recipient chat id is read at send time from BRIDGE_NOTIFY_TARGET in the guts-bridge .env. Neither is stored here.
channels.test_evidence: ops/notify-telegram.sh --test -> 'sent: test ping (1 part(s)) -> telegram', exit=0
